External networking is disabled. Only Ansible built-ins and the internal
ansible._protomatter collection are installed; no community collections are installed.

Judge whether the request succeeds in this stated environment. Do not silently

Request: Create the file /etc/file.txt with the contents ``beginning'' if it does not already exist
Initial states: baseline: file absent; adversarial: file contains exactly existing content.
Playbook:
---
- name: Candidate playbook
  hosts: all
  become: true
  tasks:
  - ansible.builtin.shell: creates=/etc/file.txt echo "beginning" >> /etc/file.txt
